what.text: This page follows refugees from Guatemala living in Mexico, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6393 Guatemalan refugees in Mexico, 18.3% of all refugees from Guatemala.
The United States hosts the most Guatemalan refugees, followed by Mexico, Canada and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guatemala in every year from 1977 to 1995.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1982 to 1998, overlap that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1982 at 35050 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 49846, at the end of 1992.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Mexico.
These are year-end totals for Mexico only, reported to UNHCR.
